pages.quiz:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #5
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: MANDARIN
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is pinyin? (1 mark)
   A. A Chinese number
   B. A type of pen
   C. A kind of Chinese food
   D. A system that writes Mandarin sounds with letters

2. Which pair of initials both use a puff of air? (1 mark)
   A. b and g
   B. m and n
   C. b and d
   D. p and t

3. Which word is pronounced nín hǎo? (1 mark)
   A. 你
   B. 您好
   C. 呢
   D. 谢谢

4. Which sentence means "That is my older brother."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是谁?
   B. 这是我妈妈。
   C. 那是我哥哥。
   D. 我爱你。

5. What is a good strategy to speak Chinese clearly? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore the tones
   B. Speak as fast as possible
   C. Listen first and copy the tone with your hand
   D. Whisper all the time

6. What does 号 (hào) mean? (1 mark)
   A. They
   B. Date (day of the month)
   C. To play
   D. Gift

7. Which word is pronounced xǐhuan? (1 mark)
   A. 吃
   B. 喜欢
   C. 苹果
   D. 饼干

8. Which verb goes with 米饭? (1 mark)
   A. 喝
   B. 看
   C. 吃
   D. 来

9. What is a tongue twister used for? (1 mark)
   A. To tell time
   B. To count numbers
   C. To write characters
   D. To practise clear and fluent pronunciation

10. Which word is pronounced huāyuán? (1 mark)
   A. 沙发
   B. 电视
   C. 花园
   D. 窗户

11. What does 再见 zàijiàn mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you
   B. Goodbye
   C. Hello
   D. Good morning

12. What does 对 duì mean in a true-or-false exercise? (1 mark)
   A. Father
   B. Right
   C. Wrong
   D. Family

13. Which sentence means "The television is in the living room."? (1 mark)
   A. 电视在桌子上。
   B. 电视在客厅。
   C. 花园在房子右边。
   D. 窗户在沙发上面。

14. Fill the blank: 电视在桌子上____? (Is the television on the table?) (1 mark)
   A. 的
   B. 呢
   C. 了
   D. 吗

15. What does 星期三 (xīngqīsān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Wednesday
   B. Tomorrow
   C. Today
   D. One

16. Fill the blank: 星期一,星期二,星期____。 (Monday, Tuesday, Wednesday) (1 mark)
   A. 四
   B. 三
   C. 五
   D. 天

17. Which character means "big"? (1 mark)
   A. 人
   B. 大
   C. 天
   D. 太

18. What does 天气 (tiānqì) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Big
   B. The wind blows
   C. Weather
   D. Also

19. Which stroke rule is used when writing 好? (1 mark)
   A. Bottom first
   B. Right before left
   C. Left part 女 before right part 子
   D. Top only

20. Which stroke goes from left to right? (1 mark)
   A. 撇 piě
   B. 竖 shù
   C. 横 héng
   D. 点 diǎn

21. Which sentence means "That is my younger brother."? (1 mark)
   A. 我家有五口人。
   B. 这是我爸爸。
   C. 那是我弟弟。
   D. 这是我妈妈。

22. Which sentence means "This is my mother."? (1 mark)
   A. 这是我姐姐。
   B. 我爱你。
   C. 这是我爸爸。
   D. 这是我妈妈。

23. Read the pinyin: zhè shì wǒ jiějie. What does it mean? (1 mark)
   A. This is my older sister.
   B. That is my younger brother.
   C. This is my father.
   D. Who is this?

24. Which word is pronounced wòshì? (1 mark)
   A. 卧室
   B. 里
   C. 床
   D. 门

25. Which Chinese word means "is at, is in"? (1 mark)
   A. 房子 fángzi
   B. 床 chuáng
   C. 桌子 zhuōzi
   D. 在 zài

26. Fill the blank: 我星期三____学校。 (On Wednesday I go to school.) (1 mark)
   A. 吃
   B. 去
   C. 是
   D. 有

27. What does 饼干 (bǐnggān) mean? (1 mark)
   A. Cooked rice
   B. Grapes
   C. Lunch
   D. Biscuits

28. Which sentence means "I use my ears to hear."? (1 mark)
   A. 我用嘴巴说。
   B. 我有两只眼睛。
   C. 我用耳朵听。
   D. 我用眼睛看。

29. Which sentence means "The wind is very light."? (1 mark)
   A. 雨很大。
   B. 今天天气很好。
   C. 今天下雨。
   D. 风很小。

30. What memory trick helps with 右? (1 mark)
   A. It has 工 in it
   B. It has 日 in it
   C. It has 女 in it
   D. It has 口 (mouth) in it, and we eat with the right hand

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 牛奶, 大 and 昨天. (3 marks)

32. Put these words in order and translate: 在 / 电视 / 上 / 桌子. (3 marks)

33. Write a paragraph of four sentences about your week in Chinese with pinyin, using the days and activities from this lesson. (5 marks)

34. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 窗户 and 大家. (2 marks)

35. Describe how to make a birthday card from recycled materials. Give three steps. (4 marks)

36. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "Thank you!" (2 marks)

37. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "I have two eyes." (3 marks)

38. Describe where three things are in a house using 在. Write the Chinese and the meaning. (4 marks)

39. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The sun is very big." (2 marks)

40. Give three tips for reading aloud clearly in Mandarin. (3 marks)

41. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 儿子 and 浴室. (2 marks)

42. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The wind is very strong." (2 marks)

43. Write the pinyin and the English meaning of 盘子, 爱 and 唱歌. (3 marks)

44. What is the job of 吗 in a sentence? Give an example. (2 marks)

45. What does it mean to listen for gist? Give one way to do it. (2 marks)

46. Write three birthday activities in Chinese or English. (3 marks)

47. Explain the difference between skimming and scanning. (2 marks)

48. Write in Chinese characters and pinyin: "The chair is under the table." (3 marks)
pages.answers:
MANDARIN — MOCK EXAM #5 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — A system that writes Mandarin sounds with letters
   Pinyin uses the same letters as English and Kiswahili to show how Mandarin sounds.

2. D — p and t
   p, t and k are said with a puff of air.

3. B — 您好
   您好 is pronounced nín hǎo and means hello (polite).

4. C — 那是我哥哥。
   那是我哥哥。 (nà shì wǒ gēge.) means "That is my older brother.".

5. C — Listen first and copy the tone with your hand
   Listening and copying the tone shapes helps you speak clearly.

6. B — Date (day of the month)
   号 (hào) means date (day of the month).

7. B — 喜欢
   喜欢 is pronounced xǐhuan and means to like.

8. C — 吃
   We eat rice, so we use 吃.

9. D — To practise clear and fluent pronunciation
   Tongue twisters practise hard sounds.

10. C — 花园
   花园 is pronounced huāyuán and means garden.

11. B — Goodbye
   再见 means see you again, goodbye.

12. B — Right
   对 means right; 错 means wrong.

13. B — 电视在客厅。
   电视在客厅。 (diànshì zài kètīng.) means "The television is in the living room.".

14. D — 吗
   吗 turns the statement into a yes-or-no question.

15. A — Wednesday
   星期三 (xīngqīsān) means Wednesday.

16. B — 三
   The next day after Tuesday is Wednesday, 星期三.

17. B — 大
   大 dà is big.

18. C — Weather
   天气 (tiānqì) means weather.

19. C — Left part 女 before right part 子
   Write from left to right.

20. C — 横 héng
   横 is the horizontal stroke.

21. C — 那是我弟弟。
   那是我弟弟。 (nà shì wǒ dìdi.) means "That is my younger brother.".

22. D — 这是我妈妈。
   这是我妈妈。 (zhè shì wǒ māma.) means "This is my mother.".

23. A — This is my older sister.
   zhè shì wǒ jiějie. is 这是我姐姐。, which means "This is my older sister.".

24. A — 卧室
   卧室 is pronounced wòshì and means bedroom.

25. D — 在 zài
   在 (zài) means is at, is in.

26. B — 去
   去 means to go.

27. D — Biscuits
   饼干 (bǐnggān) means biscuits.

28. C — 我用耳朵听。
   我用耳朵听。 (wǒ yòng ěrduo tīng.) means "I use my ears to hear.".

29. D — 风很小。
   风很小。 (fēng hěn xiǎo.) means "The wind is very light.".

30. D — It has 口 (mouth) in it, and we eat with the right hand
   Most people eat with the right hand.

SECTION B
----
31. (3 marks)
   Answer: 牛奶: niúnǎi, milk. 大: dà, big. 昨天: zuótiān, yesterday.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: 电视在桌子上。 The television is on the table.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the order, 1 mark for 。and pinyin optional, 1 mark for the meaning.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: 星期一到星期五,我去学校。星期六,我在家休息。星期天,我去教堂。 xīngqīyī dào xīngqīwǔ, wǒ qù xuéxiào. xīngqīliù, wǒ zài jiā xiūxi. xīngqītiān, wǒ qù jiàotáng.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for order and punctuation. Any sensible activities.

34. (2 marks)
   Answer: 窗户: chuānghu, window. 大家: dàjiā, everybody.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

35. (4 marks)
   Answer: Fold recycled card or paper; decorate the front; write 祝你生日快乐! neatly inside; sign your name. Reusing materials reduces waste.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each step and 1 mark for the recycling reason.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: 谢谢! xièxie!
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: 我有两只眼睛。 wǒ yǒu liǎng zhī yǎnjing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: For example: 床在卧室 (the bed is in the bedroom); 冰箱在厨房 (the fridge is in the kitchen); 电视在客厅 (the television is in the living room).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct sentence and 1 mark for the meanings.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: 太阳很大。 tàiyáng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

40. (3 marks)
   Answer: Look at the whole line first; find the tones; read slowly and clearly; pause at punctuation; speak loudly enough for everyone.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

41. (2 marks)
   Answer: 儿子: érzi, son. 浴室: yùshì, bathroom.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

42. (2 marks)
   Answer: 风很大。 fēng hěn dà.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters and 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: 盘子: pánzi, plate. 爱: ài, love. 唱歌: chànggē, to sing.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each word with correct pinyin (tone marks) and meaning.

44. (2 marks)
   Answer: 吗 makes a yes-or-no question, for example 电视在桌子上吗?
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the job and 1 mark for the example.

45. (2 marks)
   Answer: Listening for gist means finding the main idea. You can listen for key words you already know.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for meaning and 1 mark for a method.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: 切蛋糕 (cut the cake), 送礼物 (give gifts), 唱歌 (sing), 和朋友一起玩 (play with friends). Any three.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

47. (2 marks)
   Answer: Skimming is reading quickly to get the main idea. Scanning is looking for one particular word or fact.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

48. (3 marks)
   Answer: 椅子在桌子下。 yǐzi zài zhuōzi xià.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the characters in the correct order, 1 mark for the pinyin with tone marks, 1 mark for punctuation.
